implementation: Separate reviewed manifest and individual immutable pre-start records; explicit operator-reviewed application config, absent by default.
Each record has a source event and payload hash, original WorldStarted binding, actor, historical identity references, time interval, timezone, precision and privacy class.
Import uses current logical acceptance time and actual review/created timestamps; it cannot move the original runtime boundary.
One atomic batch; canonical content binding, stable idempotency, interrupted transaction rollback and cold reconstruction.
Dedicated historical identity namespace does not register NPCs or grant presence, action or runtime Experience authority.
Projection integrity and incremental semantic hashing include nonempty history fields; empty fields do not change old serialized data.
Owner dashboard exposes archive and record counts without archive body or raw historical references.

tests.transport: offline HTTP fixtures where a provider is needed

covered: Real SQLite and public application import, restart, cold replay, import twice and subsequent Clock advancement.
Wrong actor/World and review-content mismatch; even independently approved dates at or after original start are rejected.
A later import cannot fill an earlier runtime gap; source precision remains local-month correct across canonical UTC serialization.
Historical entity/type and real-user reference rejection; cross-actor related history rejection.
Forged importer, modified record with recomputed event hash, changed cached actor/source/start/body and missing cached history.
Mid-batch failure leaves no archive or records and permits retry.
Import produces no MemoryCandidate, Experience, Plan or NPC; ordinary chat does not receive the complete archive statement.
Existing memory retrieval/corpus, ledger, event catalog, owner snapshot, World response and activity continuation regression coverage.
issues_found_and_fixed: Owner field exposure policy initially lacked the new fields; explicit aggregate-only counters added.
Incremental semantic hashing initially omitted newly nonempty fields; conditional fragments and projection-to-state reconstruction updated.
Explicit source timezone and canonical content hashing preserve local interval precision across ledger UTC normalization.
remaining_required_work: Create the actual character archive and independently check semantic consistency against accepted identity, timeline and existing history. Review metadata and hashes alone do not establish semantic validity.
Connect a prehistory source kind to character-authored retention, durable MemoryCandidate authority, unified retrieval and visible expression source review.
Use the same memory access state for forgetting, compression, withdrawal and reinforcement; no direct full-archive access shortcut.
Verify complete chain replay, accelerated longitudinal recall/interference and real-model behavior, including ongoing cost.
Existing post-start unsupported experiences, source-review false acceptance and correction timeouts remain release blockers.
